track.title: Shur, Mahur (part 2)
track.notes: From 4:10 of the track 'Shur, Mahur' (two disc sides): the Mahur, about 20 cents lower than part 1. On the last side (from 6:32) the sixth is neutral, the seventh is lowered and the melody sits on the fifth.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gs2 and dwells most on B in Mahur. The line peaks at C#6 (1062.8 Hz) at 7:37.4. It closes on the tonic (C#4 → B3 → D#4 → C#5 → B3 → B4).

flags: tonic B set in the catalog (Mahur's finalis B: the major scale builds from it (0, 209, 411, 487, 694, 908, 1097 cents: B C# D# E F# G# A#) and it holds 30 % of the sounding time, 39 % on the first side. It is the string that was the Shur finalis in part 1 (240.2 Hz there; this part sounds about 17 cents lower). The vote picked the note a whole tone above (269 Hz). Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 533.5 Hz (B)
